question: The marked price of a wrist watch is ₹1,200. It is sold at two successive discounts of 5% and 8%, respectively. Find its selling price.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective discount % for successive discounts of a% and b% = a + b − (a × b) ÷ 100

Net discount = 5 + 8 − (5 × 8) ÷ 100 = 13 − 0.40 = 12.6%

Selling Price (SP) = Marked Price × (100 − Effective Discount)%

SP = 1200 × (100 − 12.6)% = 1200 × 87.4% = 1048.80

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1048.80.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked Price (MP) = ₹1,200

First discount (D₁) = 5%

Second discount (D₂) = 8%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = MP × (1 − D₁ ÷ 100) × (1 − D₂ ÷ 100)
